summary:
UI score: **9.0/10** for this import/UI scope. No blocking findings.

- Import is prominent on desktop; narrow layouts retain a clear white “+” action with accessibility label and tooltip. Sheets use the web reference’s dark cards, rounded controls, typography hierarchy, and white primary actions.
- Inspected all five 448pt import/account captures and desktop, narrow, 125% zoom, and Focus captures. No visible horizontal overflow. Narrow layouts sensibly stack controls and scroll vertically.
- Typed input survives sheet transitions through parent-owned state. Account dismissal returns to import without clearing the library error.
- Safety guards require an explicitly opened local library and signed-in account. Demo import is blocked. Duplicate imports return before fetching; tests cover occurrence/history preservation, failed responses, and stale-library protection. Cloud writes remain separate explicit actions.

Minor objections:

- Narrow navigation’s unlabeled “+” is less discoverable than “Import playlist”; consider retaining a short “Import” label.
- [NativeAccountModel.swift:256](/Users/gustavocaiano/.t3/worktrees/tubeshuffle/t3-310b873b/macos/TubeShuffle/App/NativeAccountModel.swift:256) exposes resume/refresh/session-clearing controls alongside first-time sign-in. Moving maintenance controls into Advanced settings would strengthen the primary CTA.
- Import service errors use ordinary secondary text; an error icon or stronger emphasis would improve scanning.

Evidence limits: screenshots and synthetic tests support layout and local safety, but do not prove live OAuth/API behavior or interactive sheet transitions. The supplied test log ends in `TEST SUCCEEDED`; I did not rerun tests or validate ongoing Release packaging. No edits, builds, network calls, login, or real-data access performed.
